dropped.reason: MULTI-OUTPUT WITH NO OUTPUT ARGV SLOT: mode 1 ('CUT OUT & KEEP SIGNIFICANT EVENTS') takes only 'inf' plus flags - no outfile - and writes one file PER DETECTED EVENT named from the INPUT stem ('housekeep extract 1 syl2.wav -g0.05' -> exit 0, 'INFO: 4 segments extracted.', files syl0/syl1/syl2/syl3.wav in cwd). The engine's contract is one output argv slot, one verified output, one lineage record; none of that machinery exists for N self-named outputs, and building it for one utility submode is not justified.
evidence: Output naming verified: input stem with trailing digit replaced/appended (syl2.wav -> syl0..syl3.wav), written to the process cwd.

SILENT LOSS LANDMINE: the extracted segment whose generated name collided with the existing input file (syl2.wav) was silently skipped - input untouched at 2.0 s, only 3 new files despite '4 segments extracted.' (the -n flag makes it STOP instead; default is 'ignore and continue' per the banner).

The tranche briefing's 'one output per channel' expectation was wrong - per-channel splitting is housekeep chans; extract mode 1 splits by detected EVENT (gate/threshold flags -g/-e/-t/-h/-b/-i/-l/-w).
ST covers only extract mode 4 (curated this tranche as housekeep_extract_4). Mode 1 remains reachable via execute() with cwd control.
